_comment: DIFFICULTY AXIS on the SAME-RULE rung: the positive control.
Identical to difficulty-axis-new-rule.json except for the task. This rung
holds one substitution map constant, so transfer is known to exist here
(held-out byte 0.329 -> 0.850 as data grows), which makes it the control for
Run this and difficulty-axis-new-rule.json and read them together:
- helps here, flat there  ->  evidence quantity matters for recall, not for
- helps in both           ->  the new-rule null is about something else,
- flat in both            ->  the instrument or the budget, not the task.
CAVEAT ON k=0 HERE. With a constant rule and k=0 there is nothing in the
prompt to indicate the task at all -- no demos and no rule -- so k=0 on this
rung is close to an unconditioned generation task, and a low score there is
expected rather than diagnostic. It is included so both curves have the same
x-axis, not because it is an interesting point on this rung.
